advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 9/13 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 21.69; 5/5 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 96 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 7 stops (3 both-axle, 2 front-first, 1 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.44) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
